disposition_reason: Tables 2 and 3 print lead and cadmium (mean, SD, min, max) in 45 raw milk samples from smallholder farms in 12 Huancayo districts, overall and by district.

study.design: Cross-sectional farm survey of raw milk with probabilistic-style exposure scenarios (THQ/HI)
study.origin: 12 rural districts of Huancayo province, Junin, central Peruvian Andes (3267-3902 m), smallholder pasture-fed herds
study.market: farm milk from morning milking (not retail); raw milk often sold directly in local markets
study.method: 25 mL milk, HNO3/H2O2 hot-block digestion at 85 C; MP-AES (Agilent 4200) at INIA-Huancayo
lod: LOD 0.001 mg/L (1 µg/kg) for Pb and Cd
study.qa: Calibration from NIST-traceable 1000 mg/L standards; reagent blanks, replicates, calibration checks; no matrix CRM or recovery reported

controls.control: district location (near smelters/urban El Tambo vs high-altitude districts)
controls.outcome: Pb mean El Tambo 30.63 vs 0.90-0.95 µg/kg; Cd 33.58 vs 0.90 µg/kg (p < 0.05)

unresolved: Values printed as 0.90 µg/kg (below the 1 µg/kg LOD) look like substitutions; how non-detects were handled is not stated.
Carhuacallanga Cd SD (0.70) inconsistent with its range.
Matrix reference material recoveries not reported.
Same research group reported a 2022 single-farm El Tambo study (castro-bedrinana2023-junin-raw-milk-pb-cd-as); this 2025 dataset is separate.

regulatory_or_exposure.what: Maximum permissible limits used for whole milk

regulatory_or_exposure.value: HI < 1 in all scenarios; highest 0.78 for 2-year-olds at high consumption
